# x-dialog

> Promise-based, fully typed dialogs for React and shadcn/ui. `const result = await open(dialog, payload)` returns the typed value the dialog resolved with, or `null` when it was dismissed. Dialogs stack, can be dragged and maximized, and support async close guards. Rendered with Radix or Base UI.

Two parts: `@x-dialog/react` (npm, the engine) and `components/ui/x-dialog.tsx` (shadcn registry item, the frame, owned by the app). App code imports everything from the frame file.

## Install

- Radix projects: `npx shadcn@latest add AbdenourTadjer33/x-dialog/x-dialog-radix`
- Base UI projects: `npx shadcn@latest add AbdenourTadjer33/x-dialog/x-dialog-base`
- Agent skill (optional): `npx shadcn@latest add AbdenourTadjer33/x-dialog/x-dialog-skill`

Check `components.json` for the project's `base` and `aliases.ui`.

## Core API

```tsx
import {
  Dialog,               // slots: Dialog.Body, Dialog.Footer, Dialog.Toolbar, Dialog.TitlebarActions
  DialogProvider,       // mount once near the root
  defineDialog,         // declare a dialog
  useDialogs,           // { open, dismissAll, resolve, dismiss, requestClose }
  useDialog,            // inside a surface: { id, kind, maximized, isTopmost, requestClose }
  useDialogCloseGuard,  // inside a surface: return false to stay open
  useDialogStack,       // readonly stack, for "is any dialog open"
  type DialogProps,     // { payload, resolve, dismiss }
  type DialogResult,
  type DialogPayload,
} from "@/components/ui/x-dialog"
```

## Define

```tsx
function RenameSurface({ payload, resolve, dismiss }: DialogProps<{ name: string }, string>) {
  const [name, setName] = useState(payload.name)
  return (
    <form className="contents" onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); resolve(name) }}>
      <Dialog.Body>
        <Input data-autofocus value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} />
      </Dialog.Body>
      <Dialog.Footer>
        <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={dismiss}>Cancel</Button>
        <Button type="submit">Rename</Button>
      </Dialog.Footer>
    </form>
  )
}

export const renameDialog = defineDialog<{ name: string }, string>({
  kind: "rename",                                // stable unique id
  title: (payload) => `Rename ${payload.name}`,  // string or function of payload
  description: undefined,                        // optional second line
  icon: undefined,                               // optional ComponentType<{ className?: string }>
  width: "sm",                                   // sm md lg(default) xl 2xl 3xl 4xl 5xl full
  height: "auto",                                // auto(default) tall full
  closeOnEscape: true,
  closeOnOutsideClick: true,
  maximizable: true,
  draggable: true,
  component: RenameSurface,
})
```

## Open

```tsx
const { open } = useDialogs()
const name = await open(renameDialog, { name: "roadmap.md" }) // string | null
if (name === null) return // dismissed
```

`defineDialog<void, R>` dialogs are opened as `open(dialog)` with no payload.

## Guard

```tsx
useDialogCloseGuard(async () => {
  if (!isDirty) return true
  return (await open(confirmDialog, { title: "Discard changes?", description: "…", confirmLabel: "Discard" })) === true
})
```

Runs on Escape, outside click, close button and requestClose(). resolve()/dismiss() skip it. May be async; may open dialogs; a throwing guard keeps the dialog open.

## Rules

1. Always pass both type arguments to defineDialog<Payload, Result>. Use `void` for no payload.
2. `null` always means dismissed. Never make null a meaningful Result.
3. A surface returns slots as a fragment. Never wrap Dialog.Body/Footer/Toolbar in a div. For forms use `<form className="contents">`.
4. Settle only with resolve(value) or dismiss(). Do not manage open state. Do not nest x-dialog surfaces inside shadcn's <Dialog>.
5. Mark the first input `data-autofocus` when it is not the first tabbable element.
6. Read reactive values for guards during render.
7. Open dialogs from event handlers or effects, never during render.
8. `kind` is unique kebab-case.
9. `Dialog.Footer` is x-dialog's slot, not shadcn's `DialogFooter`.
10. One <DialogProvider> per app, above every component that calls useDialogs().

## Provider props

`labels` ({ maximize, restore, close }), `exitDuration` (ms, default 200, use 0 in tests), `baseZIndex` (default 50), `onCloseGuardError(error, { id, kind })`, `frame` (custom frame component).

## Behaviour

- Stack is LIFO. Escape and outside click affect only the topmost dialog.
- Focus on open: `[data-autofocus]`, else first tabbable in the surface. Focus on close: back to the element focused when the dialog opened.
- Outside clicks inside a sonner toaster or `[data-dialog-ignore-outside]` are ignored.
- Provider unmount settles all pending promises with null.
- DOM: `[data-dialog]`, `[data-kind]`, `[data-maximized]`, `[data-topmost]`, `[data-dialog-part=overlay|viewport|drag-layer|titlebar|titlebar-actions|toolbar|body|footer]`.

## Testing

Wrap in `<DialogProvider exitDuration={0}>`. Query dialogs with `[data-dialog]` or `[data-kind="…"]` (stacked modals hide lower layers from getAllByRole).
